AR.passport_notes: Can also map directly to national ID card numbers (DNI).
AR.national_id_notes: CUIL/CUIT (11 digits) has a mod-11 check digit.

AU.national_id_notes: First digit is usually 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6. Digits 2-9 are the individual family numbers. Last digit indicates the valid version check line.
AU.driving_licence_notes: Format varies by state/territory (NSW 8, VIC 8-10, QLD 9). Issuing state REQUIRED.

AT.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.

BD.national_id_notes: 10, 13 or 17 digits depending on issue year.

BE.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.

BR.passport_notes: Uses a sequential double-letter prefix system.
BR.national_id_notes: Two mod-11 check digits; reject all-same-digit values.

CL.passport_notes: Maps safely alongside clean RUN identity arrays.

CN.passport_notes: 'E' prefix denotes Electronic/Biometric passport; older was 'G'.
CN.driving_licence_notes: Same as Resident ID number. IDP not recognised - many rentals abroad refuse.

CZ.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.

DK.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.

FI.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.

DE.passport_notes: Strict alphanumeric filter: C, F, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, R, T, V, W, X, Y, Z + digits.

GR.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.

HU.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.
HU.national_id_notes: Card serial, not personal ID number.

IN.passport_notes: First character is a letter (typically A-Z, excluding O/I), followed by 7 numbers.
IN.national_id_notes: Verhoeff checksum; never start with 0/1. PII - store hashed.

ID.national_id_notes: Region + DOB (+40 to day for female) + serial.

IE.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.

IT.national_id_notes: Final char is a computed check letter.

JP.passport_notes: First letter indicates validity period (e.g., T for 10-year, M for 5-year).
JP.national_id_notes: Check digit; legally restricted - avoid collecting.

KE.passport_notes: New East African Community (EAC) biometric passports start with 'AK'.
KE.driving_licence_notes: DL number differs from national ID on the new smart card.

LU.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.

MX.national_id_notes: Encodes DOB, sex, state; final check digit.

MA.passport_notes: Letter prefix corresponds to issuing source code.

NL.passport_notes: Excludes letter 'O' to avoid confusion with zero.

NZ.passport_notes: Modern electronic passports use a 2-letter prefix format.
NZ.driving_licence_notes: Also capture the 3-char version number on the card.

PK.national_id_notes: Last digit odd = male, even = female.

PL.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.

PT.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.

RO.passport_notes: Standardized ICAO Doc 9303 machine-readable travel document format.
RO.national_id_notes: Encodes sex/century, DOB, county; check digit.

RU.passport_notes: First two digits indicate the series/region code.
RU.driving_licence_notes: Cyrillic licence - IDP required for many countries.

SG.passport_notes: Starts with E or K, followed by 7 digits and a checksum letter.

ZA.driving_licence_notes: Card has a separate 12-digit licence number.

KR.passport_notes: 'M' for multiple entry passports; newer next-gen passport formats vary slightly.
KR.national_id_notes: Highly sensitive; avoid collecting if possible.

ES.passport_notes: Can also be 9 digits depending on series.

LK.national_id_notes: Old format ends V/X; new is 12 digits.

TR.passport_notes: Commonly starts with U followed by digits.

AE.driving_licence_notes: Emirate-issued; number differs from Emirates ID.

GB.national_id_notes: No D,F,I,Q,U,V in either prefix letter (also no O in the second); suffix A-D. NOTE: the sample QQ123456C in the source file is INVALID under these rules.
GB.driving_licence_notes: 16 chars: 5 surname + DOB-encoded 6 + initials + serial. NI (DVA) uses 8 digits.

US.passport_notes: NextGen passports can start with a letter followed by 8 digits.
US.national_id_notes: No checksum. Block area 000/666/900-999, group 00, serial 0000. NOTE: the sample 666-29-1234 in the source file is INVALID under these rules.
US.driving_licence_notes: Format varies by state - validate against a per-state table (issuing state is REQUIRED).
